study_strategy.warning: San Antonio-area records are vulnerable to confusion between native P. foetida and introduced P. lanuginosa/ciliata-type plants. Use morphology plus provenance.

quick_split: P. affinis — broad cowboy-hat leaves, floral bracts present, greenish-yellow flower, purple-black berry; Edwards Plateau native PASS.
P. foetida — densely hairy/fetid foliage, finely divided sticky bract cage, pale flower with purple-blue corona, greenish mature fruit; range HOLD.
P. lanuginosa — introduced Mexico–Guatemala species, darker angular leaves, pinker flowers, smooth red fruit; target-zone FAIL.
